incidents.detail: PDF extraction/render saved all 9 pages, but printing text failed under cp1252 on Greek lambda. UTF-8 page files then read successfully. Original failure recorded separately.
Search returned a secondary Pith assessment of another paper, 2608.27171. Not used for grading or correctness. No earlier sharp957/component review consulted.
arXiv HTML 1806.00019v2 timed out twice on targeted retrieval. The PDF was successfully read through web, and fetched in memory for SHA256.

A guessed Guha arXiv v3 URL returned 404. Abstract metadata establishes only v1. Read v1 then the actual published APS PDF; the manuscript's equation 6 attribution is confirmed in the published version.

Independent958 recorded one q<=target failure for n20, lambda=.5, a=b=0. Ratio is exactly lambda by homogeneity of relative entropy on the disjoint input block. Direct high-precision subtraction gives tiny positive residuals decreasing from about 1.6e-148 to 1.2e-658 as precision rises. No script/output was overwritten to erase the failure; DIAGNOSE958.json records the resolution.

APS direct PDF fetch returned 403 and the DOI URL was inaccessible to web. The journals.aps.org PDF was successfully displayed by web, including equation 6. Published PDF SHA256 remains unavailable; arXiv hash is not substituted.
Some batched web/console outputs were truncated. Material source passages were subsequently retrieved in targeted calls. No claim to reading every line of every foreign paper is made.
